entries.summary: A destructive button that only fires after a 1.2 second hold, filling a progress ring; releasing early cancels and drains the ring. Space and Enter work the same way.
entries.use: Deleting data, sending money or any action that must be deliberate without a confirmation dialog.

entries.title: Copy to check
entries.summary: A copy button whose two sheets scale away while a check mark draws itself, then it reverts after 1.6 seconds.
entries.use: Copy-to-clipboard buttons next to a command, token or link, where the icon confirms the action.

entries.title: Add to cart fly
entries.summary: Tapping Add to cart sends a dot flying from the button to the bag, then the badge count bumps with an overshoot.
entries.use: E-commerce add actions, saving to a list or any action whose result lives somewhere else on screen.

entries.title: Tilt card
entries.summary: A stat card that leans up to 10 degrees toward the pointer in 3D and settles flat on leave, driven by a Spring.
entries.use: Feature cards, pricing tiers or stat tiles on desktop where hover should add depth.

entries.title: Spring switch
entries.summary: A switch whose thumb stretches to 1.3 on press and overshoots into place on release.
entries.use: Settings switches where the thumb should feel physical rather than slide linearly.

entries.title: Shared element
entries.summary: A plan cover that morphs from a list tile into the detail card through the View Transitions API, with a plain crossfade when the API is missing.
entries.use: Opening a product, plan, photo or message from a list into its detail view without a jump cut.

entries.title: FLIP reorder
entries.summary: A sortable list whose rows slide to their new position instead of teleporting when the sort changes (First, Last, Invert, Play).
entries.use: Sorting or filtering a table, leaderboard or card list where the user must keep track of which row went where.

entries.title: Height spring
entries.summary: An FAQ accordion whose panels open and close with a spring on their height, overshooting slightly before they settle.
entries.use: Disclosure panels, FAQs and expandable table rows where a CSS ease feels stiff and the content height is not known in advance.

entries.title: Tab indicator
entries.summary: The package Tabs with one pill that slides and stretches under the active tab instead of each tab repainting its own background.
entries.use: Segmented controls, tab bars and filters where the eye should follow the selection from one option to the next.

entries.title: Stacked toasts
entries.summary: Toasts that slide in from above, stack with a depth cascade (each older one lower, smaller and dimmer) and leave when dismissed.
entries.use: In-app notifications that can arrive in bursts: payments, comments, exports, limit warnings.

entries.title: Sheet spring
entries.summary: A bottom sheet that springs up over its page, follows your finger when dragged down and either dismisses or springs back depending on distance and speed.
entries.use: Mobile pickers, filters, share menus and any secondary task that should feel attached to the screen instead of popping in.
names: Sheet com mola e arrastar para fechar
Hoja con resorte y arrastrar para cerrar

entries.title: Filter list
entries.summary: Filter chips over a list: rows that no longer match shrink and fade out, survivors slide into the gap, and the total counts to its new value.
entries.use: Filtering a catalog, task list or table where the user must see what disappeared and what stayed.

entries.title: Cursor spotlight
entries.summary: A pricing grid lit by a soft brand spotlight and a grid of fine lines that only shows inside the light; the light eases toward the pointer.
entries.use: Hero or feature grids where hovering should reveal structure: pricing tables, bento grids, docs landing pages.

entries.title: Grid ripple
entries.summary: A grid of dots where a click sends a wave outward: each dot swells and fades back after a delay equal to its distance from the click.
entries.use: Empty states, hero backdrops and interactive posters where a click or tap should feel like it disturbs a surface.
names: Onda de pontos a partir do clique

entries.title: Animated gradient field
entries.summary: A KPI card on a gradient field whose hue and angle drift slowly through registered CSS custom properties; the pointer takes over and paints it.
entries.use: Hero backgrounds, dashboard headers and cards that need ambient color without video, canvas or a JavaScript loop.

entries.title: Before and after slider
entries.summary: A before and after compare slider: a handle clips the old design over the new one, and a spring snaps it to 25%, 50% or 75% on release.
entries.use: Redesign showcases, image or theme comparisons, changelog visuals and onboarding that shows what a setting changes.

entries.title: Cursor trail
entries.summary: A chain of 14 dots that eases after the pointer, each one shrinking and following the dot ahead; autoplay traces a looping path.
entries.use: Playful hero sections, creative portfolios and empty canvases where the cursor should leave a soft, short-lived mark.

entries.title: Hero intro sequence
entries.summary: A hero block whose eyebrow, headline, copy and buttons enter one after another, each rising 14px and fading in, 90ms apart.
entries.use: The first screen of a landing page or the header of a feature page. The static first frame is already complete, so no content is hidden for crawlers or slow scripts.

entries.title: Card tilt with glare
entries.summary: A payment card that leans up to 10 degrees toward the pointer on a spring while a soft glare slides across its surface.
entries.use: Product cards, pricing tiers, credit cards and badges that should feel like physical objects on hover.

entries.title: Shift range selection
entries.summary: Five checkboxes where Shift+click selects the whole range from the last clicked row, using the forwarded onclick and data-testid.
entries.use: Lists and tables with row selection that need Shift range selection.

entries.title: External trigger, no list
entries.summary: A FileUpload without its built-in list, opened from an Add files button in the section header; picked names are listed by the page.
entries.use: Upload on pick with your own progress or list UI, and a header button that opens the same picker.

entries.title: Hidden label
entries.summary: Two inline TextFields whose label is kept for screen readers only with hideLabel, plus native maxlength and a bound ref.
entries.use: Inline editing in lists and toolbars where the label is implied visually but each input still needs an accessible name.

entries.title: Checkbox and radio items
entries.summary: A view menu with two checkbox items and a radio group for the sort order, kept open while options change, with the current state shown below.
entries.use: Menus that set view options: toggles (show hidden, show preview) and one choice among several (sort by).

entries.title: Submenus
entries.summary: An item menu with Rename, a Color submenu, a Move to submenu and a destructive Delete, reporting the last action.
entries.use: Menus where a secondary list (colors, destination groups) would make the main menu long: the list opens beside the item.

entries.title: Context menu
entries.summary: A dashed button area that opens a Rename, Duplicate, Delete menu at the pointer on right-click, or from the keyboard with Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key.
entries.use: Context menus on rows, files or canvases: the menu opens where the user pointed and moves when they right-click again.

entries.title: Multiple
entries.summary: A multi-select Combobox with removable chips, starting with two labels selected and echoing the array below.
entries.use: Choosing several items from a searchable list, such as labels or categories, where the list stays open between picks.

entries.title: Creatable tags
entries.summary: A multi-select Combobox that offers a Create row for text that matches no tag, and adds the new tag to its options.
entries.use: Free-form tagging where users pick existing tags or invent new ones inline.

entries.title: Async results
entries.summary: A CommandPalette whose async `search` returns grouped invoice and customer records after a simulated 600 ms server delay.
entries.use: Command palettes that search server data (records, documents, users) next to local navigation items.

entries.title: Sortable list
entries.summary: A checklist whose rows reorder by dragging a grip, by touch press-and-hold, or with the keyboard (Space, arrows, Enter).
entries.use: Any short ordered list the user curates: checklists, playlists, priorities, form field order.

entries.title: Board
entries.summary: A three-column board: cards reorder inside a column and move between columns by mouse, touch or keyboard.
entries.use: Kanban boards, status pipelines and any set of lists whose items move from one to another.

entries.title: Drop zones
entries.summary: Task chips dragged from a tray onto weekday drop zones, with a dashed highlight while a chip is over a day.
entries.use: Scheduling, assigning and filing: any place a loose item is dropped onto a target that is not a sortable list.

entries.title: Groups
entries.summary: A DataTable of tasks grouped into collapsible sprints, with a resizable Task column, drag-to-reorder rows between groups and a button inside a cell.
entries.use: Backlogs, boards in table form and any grouped list where rows are reordered or moved and cells hold controls.

entries.title: Line
entries.summary: Tabs with variant="line": bare text tabs with an underline on the active one, used as a view switcher with no panels.
entries.use: Page headers and view switchers where the tabs change what the page shows, not a panel under the list.

entries.title: Own header
entries.summary: A drawer without a title whose own header carries the item key, a heading and a close button; aria-labelledby names the panel.
entries.use: Detail panels that build their own header (key, actions) and still need an accessible name.

entries.title: Type to confirm
entries.summary: A destructive alert dialog with a rich description and a TextField body; Confirm stays disabled until the key is typed.
entries.use: Irreversible deletes that need a deliberate confirmation, such as typing the item key.

entries.title: Close on pick
entries.summary: A button showing the chosen date that opens a popover holding a calendar; picking a day closes the popover.
entries.use: A choice made inside a popover (date, option, color) that should dismiss it and hand focus back to the trigger.

entries.title: Panel width
entries.summary: An app shell whose panel starts at 280px for long item names and has a drag handle on its edge.
entries.use: Navigation lists with long labels, or when users want to choose how wide the panel is.

entries.title: Color, count, actions and reorder
entries.summary: App shell panel rows with a color dot, a neutral count, a per-row actions menu and drag-to-reorder.
entries.use: Lists of user-owned things (workspaces, folders, saved views) that need a marker, a total, quick actions and a custom order.

entries.title: Stacked controls
entries.summary: A Card titled Trending topics that stacks three Checkbox controls in a column with gap="sm", the title aligned with the controls.
entries.use: Settings and filter cards whose content is several inline controls (Checkbox, Switch, TextField) that need vertical spacing.

entries.title: Dedupe and replace by id
entries.summary: Two buttons: one fires the same error ten times and shows a single toast with a ×10 badge, the other replaces an uploading toast by id.
entries.use: Polling or parallel requests that fail with the same message, and progress toasts that turn into a result.

entries.title: Dense, pinned and grouped
entries.summary: A dense SimpleTable of leads inside an already framed, horizontally scrolling panel: compact rows, two pinned columns, collapsible stage groups, a sortable Name header and clickable rows.
entries.use: CRM or spreadsheet-like record lists that need many columns and rows: dense rows, pinned checkbox and name columns, grouped sections and keyboard-operable rows.

entries.title: Description and action
entries.summary: Three buttons that fire a toast with a description, with one inline action, and with both.
entries.use: A toast that needs a secondary line of detail or a single shortcut such as Undo, Open or Mark as qualified.

entries.title: Password
entries.summary: A sign-in pair of TextFields: a required email and a revealable password with a Forgot password link under it, neither showing an asterisk.
entries.use: Login and reset forms: the show/hide password eye, a link or strength meter under the field, and required fields without the asterisk when nothing is optional.

entries.title: Basic
entries.summary: A language switcher with three options named in their own language; picking one awaits an async onselect before the value changes.
entries.use: A language selector in a public header or settings: persist the choice, set the cookie and navigate to the localized URL, with the control busy meanwhile.

entries.title: In header
entries.summary: A site header whose trailing end holds a LocaleSwitcher next to a filled Sign up button.
entries.use: The public header of a multi-language product: language switcher plus the primary call to action, compact on a phone.

entries.title: Labels, search slot, badges and More
entries.summary: An app shell with captions under the rail icons, a search trigger on top of the rail, per-module badges and a More sheet on mobile.
entries.use: Apps with many modules, a command palette, per-module counters and role-based navigation.

entries.title: Stage
entries.summary: An app shell with a persistent stage behind the pages: mounted once, click-through content, hide and pause.
entries.use: Map, canvas, video or 3D products where the pages float over one live layer that must keep its state across routes.

entries.title: Display role
entries.summary: Three Heading samples: a fluid display headline, a smaller display-3 heading and an h2 element drawn at the h4 size.
entries.use: Rendering an editorial or marketing headline in the display font with its own tracking and leading, or decoupling a heading's look from its level.

entries.title: Animated and static
entries.summary: A sentence with one animated marker-pen highlight and one static highlight.
entries.use: Emphasizing a key phrase in a headline or paragraph with a marker sweep that falls back to the final state under reduced motion.

entries.title: Strike and rewrite
entries.summary: A rewrite line: one struck-out word with an animated pen line, followed by an animated highlighted replacement.
entries.use: Editorial strike-through-and-rewrite effects where the removed text stays announced as deleted and the animation respects reduced motion.

entries.title: Paper grain
entries.summary: Three solid Surface tiles: static paper grain, animated paper grain and no grain.
entries.use: Giving a card or panel a printed-paper texture for editorial and marketing layouts.

entries.title: Reading width with an aside
entries.summary: A PageShell with width="reading" (form column capped at 46rem) and an aside snippet holding a section index, inside a fixed-height frame.
entries.use: Settings and form pages on wide screens that need a readable column plus a companion column (in-page index, summary, help, preview).

entries.title: Short panel
entries.summary: An app shell with one module of two items and collapseShortPanel: only the rail shows, the page uses the full width.
entries.use: Small modules (settings, profile) where a 200px panel would hold two links and leave the rest empty.

entries.title: Map, split and page
entries.summary: A PageFrame floating a 352px panel over a stand-in map, with a mode switch (map, split, page), a side switch and a live readout of the covered pixels from stageInsets.
entries.use: Map-first screens where a panel sits over a live stage and the stage must keep pins and routes clear of what the panel covers.

entries.title: Neutral tone
entries.summary: One brand filled Button beside secondary actions drawn with tone="neutral": an outlined Button, a small ghost Button and an outlined IconButton.
entries.use: Dense work screens (queues, inboxes, CRMs) with one primary action and several secondary ones that must not compete with it.

entries.title: Sizes
entries.summary: Four Progress bars at 60% showing size sm (4px), size md (6px) and the default lg (8px), plus an indeterminate sm bar.
entries.use: Picking the bar thickness: thin bars for dense cards and headers, the default 8px elsewhere.

entries.title: Stats in a card
entries.summary: A Card titled This week holding three card-less Stat blocks in a responsive grid: leads with a hint, reply rate with a unit, trend and hint, and booked calls with a positive trend.
entries.use: Plain statistics inside an existing card or panel, with no nested box, instead of several KpiCards.

entries.title: Chromeless, full bleed on phones
entries.summary: A chromeless drawer for a detail view with its own header, close button and scrolling list; full width and height on phones.
entries.use: Side detail panels on desktop that become full-screen panels on phones, where the view owns its header and scroll (no double close button, no 48px page strip).

entries.title: Wrapping chips
entries.summary: Single-choice chips for a sales team size: five short options that wrap to two rows on a phone.
entries.use: Choosing one of a few short options (team size, plan length, frequency) where RadioGroup is too tall and SegmentedControl would overflow a 390px screen.

entries.title: Required choice with error
entries.summary: ChipGroup inside a native form with a required choice and a field error shown after submitting without a selection.
entries.use: A form step with one required single choice, where the error must be announced and the value must reach FormData through `name`.

entries.title: Leads pipeline
entries.summary: A three-stage leads pipeline board: status-coloured columns that scroll on their own, cards that move between columns by drag, keyboard or a Move to menu, and a New column that loads more pages.
entries.use: CRM pipelines, ticket boards and any stage board whose columns are ordered by the server and keep loading as you scroll.

entries.title: Money total per column
entries.summary: A deals pipeline board that shows the money total of each column next to its count, keeping the stage colour rail, title and count that a custom header would replace.
entries.use: Sales pipelines, invoicing stages and any board where each column needs an aggregate (sum, weight, hours) beside the card count.

entries.title: Scoped block
entries.summary: ThemeIsland as a scoped block: a light ocean island inside a dark page.
entries.use: A section or card that must use another preset or scheme than the rest of the app, without touching <html>.

entries.title: Full page
entries.summary: Full-page ThemeIsland with `document`: html and body take the island's preset and scheme while it is mounted.
entries.use: A public landing or auth page with its own preset and scheme inside an app that uses another one.

entries.title: Themed map
entries.summary: A map stage with an offline light and dark basemap, four deck.gl store circles in the brand color and zoom and compass controls.
entries.use: A map-first screen whose basemap and data layers must follow the app's light and dark theme.

entries.title: Flat panel
entries.summary: Full-page AuthLayout whose side panel is flat (solid surface, no gradient, no blobs) with a toggle back to the brand gradient.
entries.use: Sign-in pages in themes with a flat or outlined surface style, or design systems that forbid gradients.

entries.title: Sign-up field
entries.summary: A password field with a 3-step strength meter and a polite text label under it.
entries.use: Sign-up and reset-password forms that need strength feedback that does not rely on colour alone.

entries.title: Your own rule
entries.summary: A strength meter driven by your own length rule, with custom label text.
entries.use: Apps whose password policy is length-based or comes from a server rule.

entries.title: Sign-in form
entries.summary: A sign-in form with a Turnstile captcha: no token without the check, reset() after a submit.
entries.use: Public forms (sign-in, sign-up, waitlist, reset) that need a captcha token to verify on the server.

entries.title: Boot
entries.summary: A button that boots a fake app: the splash shows at least 800ms, waits for ready, then leaves and reports ondone.
entries.use: App shells that load a session or data before the first screen and must not flash the splash.

entries.title: Decorative
entries.summary: Avatars next to a visible name, marked decorative so a screen reader says the name once.
entries.use: Lists, headers and comment rows where the avatar repeats the name written beside it.

entries.title: Status tokens
entries.summary: Three lead-status pills colored by preset domain tokens, plus a canvas bar per status colored with tokenRgba.
entries.use: Status, tier or channel colors that must follow the preset and the light or dark scheme: declare them once under tokens in the theme, read them as CSS vars or as [r, g, b, a].

entries.title: Type roles
entries.summary: The six type roles (title, heading, body, label, caption, num) rendered with Text, one row each.
entries.use: Picking the text role of a line of UI: use the role instead of loose font-size, line-height and letter-spacing, so a theme `type` override restyles it.

entries.title: Component tokens
entries.summary: A dense focus-mode toolbar that restyles Button, IconButton and Kbd with component tokens on one wrapper: tighter gap and line-height, a regular-weight large button, wider small padding, a borderless ghost button, a 36px icon button and a square keycap.
entries.use: A product whose design system fixes button weight, tracking, gap, padding and keycap size per context (public area, dashboard, focus mode), without writing selectors against ca-* classes.

entries.title: Dense CRM with component tokens
entries.summary: A dense CRM activity card whose Avatar, TextField, TextArea, Card, SegmentedControl and EmptyState are restyled only through component tokens declared on one wrapper: neutral avatars, tighter field gap, a 64px note box, a hairline flat card, compact segments and a bare empty state.
entries.use: Dense work screens (activity feed, notes composer, view switcher, empty and invite states) that need a different density than the defaults without selectors against internal parts.

entries.title: Inline pill
entries.summary: A follow-up list where each row has a title and an inline subtle Badge pill with a status dot: Overdue (danger), Due today (warning), Done (success) and a neutral Draft without a dot.
entries.use: Status pills next to a title in lists and queues. The pill sits in text flow; it is not anchored to a corner like a count badge.

entries.title: Responsive keyboard hint
entries.summary: Two outlined neutral Buttons (Next lead, Snooze) with a Kbd keyboard hint in the trailing slot, marked trailingHint so the hint disappears below md and on touch screens without leaving a gap.
entries.use: Queue and inbox actions that show a keyboard shortcut on desktop only.

entries.title: Align between
entries.summary: A stack of three full-width outlined neutral Buttons with align="between": label at the start, a Kbd hint at the end; the last one is loading and keeps its spinner at the start.
entries.use: Action grids and menus of full-width buttons where the label is left-aligned and the shortcut sits on the right.

entries.title: Configured split
entries.summary: A split dialog sized 66vw by 88svh with a 2fr/3fr column ratio that goes full screen under 600px: a map column beside a details column with a Close button.
entries.use: Wide detail dialogs (map + details, media + form) that need their own box and column ratio and must fill the screen on phones.

entries.title: Profile mention
entries.summary: A sentence with an @ada mention link that opens a profile card with a name, a line of detail and a View profile link on hover or keyboard focus.
entries.use: Previewing a person, link target or record inline without leaving the page; the link itself stays the primary action.

entries.title: Delays, side and bind:open
entries.summary: An outlined Plan details button with a top-start hover card, plus a button that shows or hides the card from code and a line reporting the last user-driven change.
entries.use: Short delays, a custom side and alignment, and driving the card with bind:open while onOpenChange reports only what the user did.

entries.title: File menu
entries.summary: A dashed file area that opens a Rename, Pinned, Move to and Delete menu at the pointer on right-click, at the finger on a long touch press, or from the keyboard with Shift+F10.
entries.use: Context menus on rows, files or canvases that reuse the DropdownMenu items, including checkbox items and submenus, without wiring any event handler.

entries.title: One menu per row
entries.summary: Three invoice rows, each its own context menu with a label, Open and Send reminder, and a 400 ms long-press delay for touch.
entries.use: A menu per list row: each row is a focusable region, so keyboard users reach the same actions with Shift+F10.

entries.title: Editor menu bar
entries.summary: An application menu bar with File, Edit, View and a disabled Help menu; File has a submenu, View has a checkbox and a radio group, and a line below reports the last action.
entries.use: A desktop-style application or editor menu bar: arrows move between menus, an open menu switches on hover or ArrowRight and ArrowLeft.

entries.title: Bar open state
entries.summary: A two-menu bar (Share, Insert) with a line reporting whether any menu is open through onOpenChange.
entries.use: Reacting to the bar as a whole, for example dimming a canvas while a menu is open, without tracking each menu.

entries.title: Marketing header
entries.summary: A marketing header nav with Products and Resources disclosure buttons that open panels of links (Products links carry a description), followed by Pricing (the current page) and Contact links.
entries.use: The primary navigation of a marketing site: a few top-level links and a couple of grouped panels, reachable by hover, click and keyboard.

entries.title: Delays and alignment
entries.summary: A two-item docs nav (Guides, Reference) that opens on hover at once and stays open 400 ms after the pointer leaves.
entries.use: Tuning how eager the hover behaviour is for dense navigation, and aligning each panel to its button's start or end.

entries.title: ratio and fit
entries.summary: One 4:3 gradient file rendered in three boxes: ratio 16/9 (cropped), ratio 1 (cropped) and ratio 1 with fit contain (letterboxed).
entries.use: Card covers, thumbnails and avatar grids where every picture must share one box whatever its own proportions.

entries.title: Embed
entries.summary: An AspectRatio of 16/9 inside a 28rem frame holding a centred caption, standing in for a video or iframe.
entries.use: Embeds, maps and video players that have no intrinsic size but must hold a ratio while loading.

entries.title: Two panels
entries.summary: A two-panel horizontal group (Files 25%, Editor 75%) in a bordered frame with a caption showing the live percentages.
entries.use: Split views where the user sizes a side panel: file trees, inspectors, mail readers.

entries.title: Nested and saved
entries.summary: A persisted horizontal group (Folders, Main) whose Main panel holds a vertical group (Messages over Reader).
entries.use: Three-pane layouts (mail, issue trackers) where the layout survives a reload.

entries.title: Highlights
entries.summary: A four-slide carousel (Plan, Build, Ship, Learn) with arrows and dots, bound to an index shown in a caption.
entries.use: Feature highlights, onboarding steps or testimonials where one item shows at a time.

entries.title: Several per view
entries.summary: Five plan cards shown three at a time in a looping carousel.
entries.use: Card rows that overflow: pricing tiers, related products, team members.

entries.title: Autoplay
entries.summary: A looping three-quote carousel that advances every 4 seconds, with a Pause button and no arrows.
entries.use: Rotating testimonials or announcements; autoplay is opt-in and always stoppable.

entries.title: Text, icon and filled groups
entries.summary: Three ButtonGroups: text buttons (Day, Week, Month), icon buttons (Bold, Italic, Underline) and a filled plus destructive pair.
entries.use: Related actions that read as one control: a range switcher, a formatting toolbar, an approve and reject pair.

entries.title: Split button and vertical
entries.summary: A split button (Publish plus a chevron DropdownMenu trigger) and a vertical ButtonGroup of two icon buttons.
entries.use: A primary action with its alternatives behind a menu, or a stacked pair of icon controls.

entries.title: Text addons
entries.summary: Five TextFields with text addons inside the border: a URL (https:// and .com), a price ($ and USD), a small @handle, an error with a .dev suffix and a disabled one.
entries.use: Fields whose value needs fixed context: a URL scheme, a currency, a handle, a unit or a domain suffix.

entries.title: Button addons
entries.summary: Two TextFields with a button inside the border: a read-only share link with a copy IconButton and a coupon code with an Apply button.
entries.use: A field with its own action: copy a value, apply a code, submit a search, with the button keeping its own name and Tab stop.

entries.title: Trend tone
entries.summary: Three KPI cards where the trend colour follows what is good news: churn falling is green, response time rising is red, sessions are neutral.
entries.use: Metrics where down is good (churn, cost, latency) or where a change is not a judgement, with an accurate better/worse screen reader label.

entries.title: Sparkline
entries.summary: Two KPI cards with an icon and a sparkline under the number: a line for active users and bars for churn, with a hint line.
entries.use: A metric tile that shows its recent history. The chart is a snippet, so the charts subpath stays out of the core entry.

entries.title: Inline content
entries.summary: A button pair inside a PreviewStage at 390 px, with a toolbar button that flips the content between light and dark.
entries.use: Showcasing a component at phone, tablet and desktop width inside a docs page or a design review.

entries.title: A whole page
entries.summary: A whole page (the sign-in template) in a PreviewStage iframe, laid out at the chosen width with its own media queries.
entries.use: Showing a full page or a template at real phone, tablet and desktop widths with isolated styles.

entries.title: Hear it
entries.summary: A sound toggle with volume, a profile picker (system, glass, brutalism, terminal) and a board of buttons that each play one cue.
entries.use: Let people audition a sound profile before turning interface sound on in an app.

entries.title: Components
entries.summary: Button, Switch, Tabs, Slider, Toast and Dialog with their sound prop on, behind one sound toggle.
entries.use: Show which components speak when the sound prop is set, and that they stay silent until the toggle is on.

entries.title: Brand color
entries.summary: Color field with a swatch, a native picker, a text input and a live WCAG contrast readout against white.
entries.use: Picking a brand or accent color where contrast matters.

entries.title: Text color
entries.summary: Color field for a text color measured against a white page, with a sample line in that color.
entries.use: Choosing text colors that must reach WCAG AA.

entries.title: Label and number
entries.summary: Two labelled sliders with an editable number and a unit: radius and type scale.
entries.use: Tuning a numeric setting where both scrubbing and typing an exact value matter.
